title: Bounded directed routes
instructions: From warehouse 1 enumerate routes of one through three directed edges without revisiting a node. Return destination, numeric-ID path, hop count, and sum of minutes.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes from_id,to_id,minutes from route_edges without solving bounded directed routes.

hints.text: Bound recursion by both hop count and visited identities.
Carry destination, path, hops, and accumulated cost; exclude the zero-hop anchor from output.
The edge 4 to 2 must not revisit 2 on path 1>2>4, but is valid after 1>3>4.
